## Try It Out!
### Add new Sharetribe users to Mailchimp audience

Automatically add every new marketplace user to your Mailchimp email audience. Keep your mailing list in sync with your marketplace signups without any manual work.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for new user creation events and returns the full user resource including their email.
* The Mailchimp node adds or updates the subscriber in your chosen audience using the user's email address.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Mailchimp account.
3. Select your target Mailchimp audience in the Mailchimp node.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Mailchimp account with at least one audience

### How to customize
* Add an IF node to filter by user type (e.g., only add providers or buyers).
* Map additional Sharetribe profile fields (first name, last name) to Mailchimp merge fields.
* Add tags in Mailchimp to segment marketplace users.
* Set Double Opt-In to true if required by your email compliance needs.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new users
The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `user/created` events with the full resource included, providing the user's email address for Mailchimp.

## 2. Add to Mailchimp
Adds or updates the subscriber in your Mailchimp audience. Double opt-in is disabled by default — enable it if required by your email compliance setup.
